en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Musa Bin Talha, from Abu Bakr Bin Isa Bin Ahmad Al Alawy who said,

‘I was in the Masjid and they had come with a dead body, so I wanted to pray Salaat upon it. Abu Al Hassanasws the 1st came up and placed his elbow upon my chest and heasws kept pushing me until I exited from the Masjid, as heasws said: ‘O Abu Bakr! The dead body cannot be prayed upon in the Masjid’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Musa ibn Talhah from abu Bakr ibn ‘Isa ibn Ahmad al-‘ Alaviy who has said the following:

“Once I was in the Masjid when a dead body was brought in and I wanted to perform Salah (prayer) for the deceased. Abu al-Hassan, al-Awwal, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, came to me, placed his elbow against my chest and pushed me back all the way out of the Masjid and then said, ‘O abu Bakr, Salah (prayer) for deceased people is not performed in Masjid.”’
